name: [7.5] Chasing Immortality [OPEN TEST]
desc:
Chasing Immortality is a 𝐭𝐞𝐱𝐭-𝐛𝐚𝐬𝐞𝐝 game with 2d visuals and 2d battles! 
Game is heavily inspired by murim and cultivation sub genres.
You will start as a mere mortal and rise through the heavens. Join a sect or go rogue, master your affinities, and unlock the secrets of true power.

⚔️ Forge Your Own Path
Will you battle through endless enemies or find peace through meditation?
♟️Defeat grandmasters and masters in chess, and earn comprehension!
👹Join the demonic path and aim to become either a demon god or a demon pawn...
🌿 Create pills using herbs you find in the forest to become the best pill master...
Use those pills to become powerful and overtake the world!
📜Join different sects and take on quests and defeat enemies around the world!
💰 Create your business, become the richest merchant in the world!


Every choice you choose will determine your fate as you continue
